description: Main commercial benchmark: same coding model, Control (original repo + test + normal trace) vs Treatment (same inputs + Faultline minimal repro + causal evidence). Measure valid fix rate, root-cause accuracy, regression pass rate, tokens, context bytes, tool calls, wall time, cost, incorrect patches. Desired result: correct fixes X->Y while cutting agent context by Z% (Rules A, C, D).
